svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a blanket of three metal films, a thick silver one between two thin purple ones, lies on a flat pale oxide over buried metal, and carries a raised thin purple plate at the right. After it two violet resist blocks stand on the blanket: a narrow one at the left and a wide one covering the plate and reaching past its edge.

svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the metal reticle
and developed, leaving it wherever metal is to remain.
After: resist over a line and the whole capacitor
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
